scripts.build-cjs: esbuild src/index.ts src/render.ts src/context.ts src/util.ts src/htm.ts src/htm.browser.ts src/render-support.ts src/preact.ts --bundle --packages=external --format=cjs --keep-names --tsconfig=tsconfig.build.json --outdir=./dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --sourcemap
scripts.build-esm: esbuild src/index.ts src/render.ts src/context.ts src/util.ts src/htm.ts src/htm.browser.ts src/render-support.ts src/preact.ts src/preact.browser.ts --bundle --packages=external --splitting --format=esm --metafile=dist/meta.json --keep-names --tsconfig=tsconfig.build.json --outdir=./dist --sourcemap && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.build.json --outDir dist
scripts.build-esm:min: esbuild src/index.ts src/render.ts src/context.ts src/util.ts src/htm.ts src/htm.browser.ts src/render-support.ts src/preact.browser.ts --format=esm --keep-names --bundle --external:preact --tsconfig=tsconfig.build.json --minify --out-extension:.js=.min.js --outdir=./dist --sourcemap

scripts.build: mkdir -p ./dist && rm -rf ./dist/* && npm run build-cjs && npm run build-esm && npm run build-esm:min && npm run build:node && npm run build:cli
scripts.version: npm run toc && npm run toc:hydration && auto-changelog -p --template keepachangelog --breaking-pattern 'BREAKING CHANGE:' && npm run inject-size && git add CHANGELOG.md README.md
